title: Personal Advertisement Appearing In The Evening Echo

page_data.en:
C.C.
H.M. 2
G. 90M-1-39

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 9440
S. 1, Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date September 15, 1939.

Subject Personal advertisement appearing in the Evening Echo.

Made by D.I.S. Roberts Forwarded by R.W. Macadie D.S.S.

Respecting the attached advertisement published
in the Evening Echo on September 13, 1939, same was
inserted to the order of C. BROOKS.

A registered letter (No. 4859) dated August 25,
1939, written on American President Lines' Stationery,
posted from s.s. "President Taft" was produced by the
editor of the above newspaper.

The letter requested that a copy of the
newspaper be sent to BROOKS and that all replies be
forwarded to C. BROOKS, Box 3, Uganda, East Africa.

Further particulars concerning BROOKS cannot
be ascertained, the editor states that apart from the
information contained in the letter he knows nothing
about him whatsoever but said that any further
communication or particulars received would be
forwarded to Police.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / SEP 15 1939 / DEPUTY COMMISSIONER / SPECIAL BRANCH）

D. C. (Special Branch).

J. J. Roberts.
D. P. S.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 9440
S. 1，特别巡捕房分站，
报告
日期：1939年9月15日。

事由：《晚声报》刊登的个人征婚广告。

由特别情报科督察罗伯茨（D.I.S. Roberts）呈报，经副特别巡捕长麦克阿迪（R.W. Macadie, D.S.S.）转呈。

关于附上的于1939年9月13日在《晚声报》（Evening Echo）刊登的广告，该广告系应 C. BROOKS 之委托刊登。

上述报纸编辑出示了一封 dated 1939年8月25日的挂号信（第4859号），信纸为美国总统轮船公司（American President Lines）抬头，从“塔夫脱总统号”轮船（s.s. "President Taft"）寄出。

信中要求将一份报纸寄给 BROOKS，并将所有回复转寄至东非乌干达的 C. BROOKS，3号信箱。

关于 BROOKS 的进一步详情无法查明，编辑称除了信中所含信息外，他对此人一无所知，但表示任何收到的进一步通信或详情都将转交警方。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 1939年9月15日 / 副总监 / 特别处）

特别处副总监。

J. J. 罗伯茨。
特别巡捕长。

EVENING ECHO

SEP 1 3 1939

PERSONAL
British Canadian now on a world tour, desires to meet
well educated Chinese lady of good appearance and
family with view to matrimony. Age between 27 and
30. One that would be prepared to live in Kenya
Colony and fond of animals, motoring and outdoor life.
Good home and social surroundings. Further particu-
lars on communication. All correspondence together
with photos in strict confidence. Apply Box 210, The
Evening Echo.

S O S Roberts
fund

《晚声报》

1939年9月13日

个人启事
一位正在进行环球旅行的英裔加拿大人，希望结识一位受过良好教育、相貌端庄、出身良家的中国女士，以结婚为目的。年龄介于27至30岁之间。愿意前往肯尼亚殖民地生活，喜爱动物、驾车及户外生活。提供良好的家庭和社会环境。进一步详情可通过通信联系。所有往来信件及照片均严格保密。请投寄《晚声报》210号信箱。

S O S 罗伯茨
基金
9月14日
